0022600153.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder (4-1, 1st in the Northwest, 3rd in the West, currently on a one-game losing streak) visit the Houston Rockets (5-1, 2nd in the Southwest and 0.5 games back, 2nd in the West) in the Thunder's sixth game of the season. Oklahoma City is without Alex Caruso (ankle), Cason Wallace (shoulder, surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Nikola Topic (back), and Thomas Sorber (knee), while Houston is missing Steven Adams (calf strain) and has Alperen Sengun (back soreness) and Reed Sheppard (back) listed as day-to-day game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Thunder won their 2025-26 season series 2-1, though they lost the most recent meeting 112-106 in Oklahoma City on February 7, 2026.
